topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Propose an alternative for a reinsurer who doesn't want mandatory acceptance of reinsurance but simply a choice to accept or reject it.
o: Go for a non-proportional reinsurance contract
e: Correct answer: Go for facultative reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Investments in long term debentures are considered approved investment if the credit rating is ________.
e: Correct answer: AA (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ________ are cheques that are issued by an accountant but not yet presented to bank.
e: Correct answer: Outstanding cheques (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: According to which concept, the proprietor pays interest on drawings.
e: Correct answer: Business entity concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following items would not fall under the definition of an asset?
e: Correct answer: Owners equity (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What would you refer an expense as which is paid and recorded in advance?
e: Correct answer: prepaid expense (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Insurance Company wants to know a suitable reinsurance arrangement when they are left with the sum remaining to be insured after both his retention and obligatory reinsurance capacity is exhausted. Advise.
e: Correct answer: Facultative reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Under this method of depreciation, revaluation is done both at the beginning and at the end of the accounting period and the difference thus arrived at is written off as depreciation through Profit and Loss Account. Which method is this?

I. Revaluation Method
II. Unit Charging Method
III. Straight Line Method
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which section of Companies Act requires that accounts shall be prepared to comply with all the mandatory Accounting Standards (AS) issued by the ICAI?
e: Correct answer: Section 209 of the Companies Act (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The following is the information pertaining to New Imperial Insurance Co. Ltd for their marine insurance division:

I. On 31.12.2010 the reserves for unexpired risk for marine insurance business - Rs. 22.5 crores
II. Reserve for unexpired risk provision is as per the Insurance Act 1938
III. Premium collected from insured in respect of policies insured - Rs. 27 crores
IV. Premium collected from other insurance companies - Rs. 10 crores
V. Premia paid/payable to other insurance companies on business ceded - Rs. 10 crores

Calculate the change in unexpired risk reserve account during the year.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 5 crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
In preparing financial statements of general insurance company, which of the following regulations need to be complied?

I. The Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act 2015
II. The Insurance Regulatory and Development Act, 1999
III. The Companies Act, 2013
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per the accounting policies adopted in General Insurance companies, depreciation on fixed assets held in foreign branches and agencies is provided on ______________.
o: Market value at the year end
Written down rupee value at the year end
e: Correct answer: Written down rupee value at the year end (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The principle of consistency means that:

I. The effect of any change in an accounting method will be disclosed in the financial statements or notes thereto
II. The same accounting methods are used by all firms in an industry
III. There are no alternative methods of accounting for the same transaction
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following documents, data and particulars are generally contained in the annual report of a general insurance company?

I. Policy on Director's Appointment and Remuneration
II. Fraud Risk Management Policy and Whistle Blower Policy
III. Performance of Human Resources Development and Personnel Dept. & Human Capital Management
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per the accounting policies adopted in General Insurance companies, Ex-gratia payable and additional actuarial liability, net of tax benefits, for pension, gratuity and leave encashment on account of Special Voluntary Retirement Scheme during 2003-04 is being amortised over a period of how many years?
e: Correct answer: 5 years (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The main object of providing depreciation is _____________.
e: Correct answer: To provide funds for replacement. (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per AS 23 Accounting for Investment in Associates In Consolidated Financial Statements, which of the following methods is / are features of an associate company?

I. Investor has significant influence
II. Investor has control
III. The investor has more than 50% shares
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Greenwich Synergy Ltd. A general insurance company is planning to invest in approved investments . What is the maximum investment limit allowed under section 27B(3) of the IRDAI Act?
e: Correct answer: 55% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: No company shall buy-back its shares unless the buy-back is, _______ or less of the total paid-up equity capital and free reserves of the company.
e: Correct answer: 25% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The difference between the acquisition cost and the redemption value of Short Term Money Market Instruments such as Commercial Papers and Certificates of Deposit is apportioned on time basis and recognised as ____________
e: Correct answer: Accrued expense (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per IRDAI regulations, every insurers having Asset under Management (AUM) not more than Rs.1,000 crores should ________.
o: Appoint a Chartered Accountant Firm for concurrent
Have a full time Company Secretary
Have a quarterly audit done by a qualified Charter
Should have a risk management department
e: Correct answer: Have a Quality Internal Audit (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: __________is a method employed by the direct insurer to dispose off the surplus risks in excess of its capacity to retain.
e: Correct answer: Reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is true about a trial balance?
o: It lists down the balances of accounts
It is not a part of accounting cycle
It is a kind of financial statement
It lists down the balances of a balance sheet
proves the accuracy of the accounting records
e: Correct answer: It lists down the balances of accounts (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In accordance with IRDAI (Preparation of Financial Statements and Auditor's Report of Insurance Companies) Regulations, 2002, how should the premium income be recognised?
o: Over the contract period or the period of risk, whichever is appropriate
When it is paid by the insured
e: Correct answer: Over the contract period or the period of risk, whichever is appropriate (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Workmen's Compensation under dispute is an example of which of the following?
e: Correct answer: Contingent  Liability (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Queba insurance Ltd. wants to know as to when will it have to appoint a chartered accountant firm for concurrent audit. Advise.
o: When Queba Ltd. Has Assets under Management (AUM)  more than Rs.10,000 crore shall have a Quality Concurrent Audit
Queba Ltd. shall have a Quality Internal Audit eve
When Queba Ltd. Has net worth of not more than Rs.
e: Correct answer: When Queba Ltd. Has Assets under Management (AUM)  more than Rs.10,000 crore shall have a Quality Concurrent Audit (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
ABC General Insurance Co Ltd gives the following details for 2009-10:

I. Gross Direct Premium Income Rs. 981 crore
II. Premium on Reinsurance Accepted Rs. 343 crore
III. Premium on Reinsurance Ceded Rs. 437 crore
IV. Net Premium for 2008-09 Rs. 913 crore

Calculate Net Premium Account.
e: Correct answer: Rs.900 crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is applicable to a finance lease?

I. If the lessee cancel lease, the lessor's loss associated with the cancellation are borne by the lessee
II. Gains or losses from the fluctuation in the fair value of the residual fall to the lessee
III. The lessee can continue the lease for a secondary period at a rent which is lower than market rent
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The Board of Directors of a Company can declare interim dividend. Debate. Choose the most appropriate options.
o: The shareholders have to declare the interim divid
Interim dividend can be declared only on approval
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Accountant of a general insurance company wants to calculate the growth rate of shareholder's fund. Kindly provide him the correct formula.
o: (Shareholder's Funds of current year - Shareholder's Funds of previous year)/ Shareholder's Funds of previous year
e: Correct answer: (Shareholder's Funds of current year - Shareholder's Funds of previous year)/ Shareholder's Funds of previous year (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: For any change in the accounting policy, there must be a full, fair and adequate disclosure of such change and the impact thereof in the 'Notes on accounts' as per ______.
e: Correct answer: AS - 1 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As an accountant you are required to make entries in the cash book and then prepare the bank reconciliation statement. Which entries will you incorporate in the cash book?

I. Cheques issued but not presented
II. Cheques deposited but not credited
III. Cheque deposited wrongly credited twice by the bank
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The newly released accounting standards in India, based on the IFRS version formulated by the __________.
o: Securities and Exchange Board of India
e: Correct answer: Accounting Standards Board of ICAI (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In which book of original entry would discounts received be recorded?
e: Correct answer: Cash Book (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Explain 'Ceding commission'.
o: The IRDA dictates the maximum commission which can
The IRDA suggests the percentage of commission whi
The reinsurer agrees to pay commission by way of percentage of reinsurance premium given to him. This is 'Ceding commission'
The Insurance Act, 1938 has prescribed certain per
The Second Schedule to IRDA Act, has prescribed ce
e: Correct answer: The reinsurer agrees to pay commission by way of percentage of reinsurance premium given to him. This is 'Ceding commission' (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Arrange the proper sequence of the process of accounting (starting from first).

I. Posting to ledger
II. Preparing Trial balance
III. Recording journal entries
IV. Preparing balance sheet
e: Correct answer: III, I, II and IV (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per AS 22 Accounting for Taxes and income, tax expense includes:-
e: Correct answer: Current tax + Deferred  tax (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
No company shall capitalize its profits or reserves for the purpose of issuing fully Paid-up bonus shares unless which of the following conditions are fulfilled?

I. The partly paid-up shares, if any outstanding on the date of allotment, are made fully paid-up
II. It has been authorised by the Board
III. It has not defaulted in payment of interest or principal in respect of fixed deposits or debt securities
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which one of the following may have been recorded in the Cash Book and fails to appear in the bank statement?

I. Bank commission
II. Cheques issued but not presented
III. Cheques issued but presented
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Where the branch office is situated in a country outside India, the branch auditor could also be an accountant duly qualified to act as an auditor of the accounts of the branch office in accordance with the laws of that country. Debate.
o: A duly qualified auditor is to be sent from India
The auditor cannot be appointed as per the laws of
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Matching concept means:

I. Assets = Liabilities + Capital
II. Transactions recorded at accrual concept
III. Expenses should be matched with the revenue of the period
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following shall be a part of the annual report of an insurance company?

I. Auditor's Report
II. Director's report
III. Shareholder's funds and policy holders' funds details
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In the accounting process, the trial balance is prepared after ___________.
e: Correct answer: Balancing ledger (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The financial statements in general insurance business shall include which of the following?

I. Balance Sheet,
II. Revenue Accounts,
III. Profit and Loss Account and
IV. Receipts and Payments Account
e: Correct answer: I, II, III and IV (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which section of the Companies Act 2013 stipulates that it shall be the duty of the Board of Directors of a company to prepare, for disclosure to shareholders, a Financial Statement, including consolidated financial statement?
e: Correct answer: Section 134 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The process of identifying, measuring, analyzing, and communicating financial information needed by management to plan, evaluate, and control an organization's operations is called:-
e: Correct answer: Managerial Accounting (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is a capital expenditure?

I. Wages paid to machine operator.
II. Rent of the premise where machine is placed.
III. Carriage paid on purchase of machine.
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The __________ is the book in which transactions are recorded for the first time. It is also known as the 'Book of Original Record' or 'Book of Primary Entry'.
e: Correct answer: Journal (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Long-Form Reports (LFAR) provides information on:-

I. Process lapses
II. Opinion on financial statements
III. Internal control
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC46 question bank).
